summary: Implement single-host NFS, local OpenZFS dataset, SMB3 and exclusive-host iSCSI VM repositories. API impact: changed contract and new contract for typed storage, lifecycle, protocol negotiation and transient credentials; acceptance is in progress.

guide.reason: Document registration, credentials, Core readiness, VM selection, recheck and safe detach for the development build.

api.reason: API impact: changed contract, with new credential and lifecycle routes. Both Controller and Core implement typed registration, generation/tombstone inventory and protocol v2, including authentication, authorization, validation and retry contracts.

roadmap.reason: Single-host storage integrations are now implemented and in testing; multi-host storage remains outstanding.

state.reason: Core owns repository source, stable identity, name, generation, lifecycle results and credentials; Controller retains only a disposable inventory projection and transient secret handoffs.
state.record: Pool master managed-vms journal AppliedStorage records plus private storage-credentials files, receipts and scoped iscsi-owners records under the agent state directory. Applied emits repositories/tombstones and credential receipts through Inventory.managed in authenticated host reports; a fresh Controller reconstructs IDs, names and VM references without credential re-entry. New SMB repositories also retain a Core-created opaque identity marker on the share; its expected marker ID is in AppliedStorage and is recovered through the same inventory.

verification.method: Focused suites, web typecheck/build and simulated Chromium regression passed; actual disposable Core/Controller testing and independent native re-review are in progress. See QA for executed results and open gates; no final backend acceptance claimed.
